summary: Tested new admin auth + license gate feature end-to-end. All 9 backend pytest tests PASS and full frontend Playwright flow PASS. Admin login (correct & wrong password), JWT-protected licencias CRUD, suspend/activate toggle, registrar pago, delete, license gate block screen on suspend, and dashboard resumes after reactivate — all working. Demo license NEXO-DEMO-0001 left ACTIVA as required.

issues: React warning: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — accessibility warning only, non-blocking

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to Nuevo cliente dialog to fix Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: LicenseGate.jsx reads REACT_APP_LICENSE_KEY at module import time (top-level const). This is fine for current use but means changing the license key in localStorage requires a full page reload — acceptable since the block/unblock flow already requires reload.
server.py estado endpoint accepts form-encoded 'estado' via Form(...); frontend uses FormData — verified compatible. Consider using JSON body for consistency with other endpoints (minor).
get_current_admin raises 401 with generic 'No autenticado' — good. JWT_SECRET falls back to 'change-me' if env var missing — flag for prod hardening.
startup_seed correctly resets admin password if it drifts (idempotent). bcrypt used with $2b$ hash — compliant.
server.py file is ~830 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting auth/licencias into a separate router module.
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted a TEST_ 'UI_Test_Cliente SL' license during UI test. Backend test also created & deleted a TEST_Empresa SL license. No lingering test data. Demo license NEXO-DEMO-0001 confirmed ACTIVA at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature (admin auth + licensing) is stable and passes all tests. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_auth_licencias.py. Prior ERP CRUD tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from iteration 1 were not re-run per request. AI PDF extraction remains blocked by 0 LLM balance — do not test.
